Imperial Guard is introduced as a new faction, and all races including the races from the original game and the first expansion (the Eldar, the Space Marines, Chaos, the Orks and the Tyranids) are playable in single-player. Dawn of War II: Retribution offers a campaign for every race, including the Imperial Guard.
